value.rationale: The 2026 counterexample only certifies that a fixed lattice admits two different Jacobian-syzygy degrees. Its natural deformation question is whether the drop is generic, divisorial, multiple isolated points, or a unique exceptional point. The complete labelled moduli parameter and sharp unique-drop theorem settle that precise missing geometric structure. The value arises from classifying the failure mechanism for a prominent nine-line Terao-type counterexample, not from an arbitrary coordinate slice or reproducing known rank tables.
